PR (cited in the notes as #21792): fix(tests): Improved the e2e tests for app sync with impersonation feature [closed]
This PR is aimed at improving some of the constructs used for the E2E tests for validating the Application Sync with Impersonation feature.

Earlier versions of these tests, did not use any custom actions for enabling this feature and relied only on add-hoc functions created specifically for the sync tests. This makes the code not re-usable. As part of this PR, I have redesigned these tests and added custom `Actions` and `Consequences` required to validate the feature.
